description: Authentication mechanisms do not prevent replay attacks where captured credentials are reused. This signal indicates that intercepted authentication data may be replayed to gain unauthorized access.
applicability: Applicable to network authentication and privileged access. Includes challenge-response protocols, time-based tokens, nonce usage, and session binding mechanisms.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through authentication protocol analysis, replay attack testing, and session management review.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Identification and Authentication
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
